name: silhouette-group-collage
title_zh: 把合影变成上下双联正负形剪影拼贴画
tagline_zh: 同学会散场后，那张糊掉的合影还能救。它把人物抠成黑白正负形，上下镜像对开，原片人物保留皮肤纹理。
tagline_en: That blurry group photo from the reunion still has a second life. It carves people into black-and-white.
desc_en: Frozen v1 baseline for transforming user-supplied group photos into vertical diptych silhouette collages using reciprocal positive-negative masks, source-pixel-locked original people, tactile paper fields, preserved film texture, scene-matched handwriting, and sparse handmade stars. Use when the user asks for 剪影群像风格, 剪影群像风格 v1, silhouette group collage, 群像剪影拼贴, 正负形镜空, 上下双联画, youth-memory group art
why_zh: 不是简单抠图加滤镜。它用互为正负的掩膜让上下两联严丝合缝，人物像素锁定原片，纸纹与胶片颗粒分层叠加。
why_en: Not a cutout-plus-filter. It uses reciprocal masks so the two panels interlock perfectly, locks people to source pixels, layers.
limit_zh: 只吃合影类多人照片，单人照或半身特写会构图失衡；输出固定为上下双联竖版，不生成横版或九宫格；手写体需本机装有中文字体库。
limit_en: Only group photos; single portraits or close-ups break the layout. Fixed vertical diptych only—no horizontal or grid. Requires local Chinese fonts.
title_en: Turn group photos into vertical diptych silhouette collages
